LEAVING THE FAMILY OF ORIGIN and ENTERING PARENTHOOD taken as the two critical steps, in ITALY, compared before and after the global crisis. American Community Survey profile comparing CORESIDING with NON-CORESIDING young adults on enrolment, employment, wages, PARENTHOOD and marriage. Exactly the contrast the registered claim implies -- and exactly the contrast §3 says is uninterpretable, since it conditions on having launched. Valuable as the descriptive benchmark and as the clearest instance of the chapter's central identification problem.

No abstract; international marriage in Japan as a strategy to MAINTAIN RURAL FARM HOUSEHOLDS. Household continuity as the motive for marriage -- the stem-family mechanism in a contemporary setting.

No abstract, but the title states the method and the estimand: SEQUENCE ANALYSIS of the transition to adulthood and ACCESS TO REPRODUCTION in nineteenth-century East Belgium. The sequence approach §3 wants, applied to the arrangement-to-birth chain; pre-modern, so A.7's under Ruling 2.
Dutch 1984 cohabitation dataset, including having an INTIMATE RELATIONSHIP WITHOUT LIVING TOGETHER. Data source, and it measures the living-apart-together configuration directly.

Predictors of gender-role views in Poland. D.2.a's.

PUBLISHED VERSION of Aparicio-Fenoll and Oppedisano. Spain's 2008 monthly cash subsidy conditional on renting, DiD on the ELIGIBILITY AGE THRESHOLD, with living apart from parents, living with a partner AND CHILDBEARING as outcomes, larger for lower earners and in high-rent areas. The chapter's single identified pre-launch design; keep this over the SSRN preprints in batches 12 and 14.
Marriage and child care as intermediate fertility determinants in three Sahelian populations.
No abstract; intergenerational co-residence and SCHOOLING. Arrangement as exposure, education as outcome.
Theological essay.
Influence of young adult children LIVING AT HOME over parents' holiday decisions. The pre-launch arrangement as exposure, consumption as outcome.

No abstract, but 'Parenthood and Leaving Home in Young Adulthood' in Population Research and Policy Review names both links and the pre-launch population. Direction of the arrow is not visible from the title and matters -- trace.

THE EXTENDED ARM'S BEST RECORD. Duration to FIRST BIRTH among Taiwanese married women born 1933-68, treating CO-RESIDENCE WITH THE HUSBAND'S PARENTS and labour supply as ENDOGENOUS, with a full-information maximum-likelihood duration model with endogenous binary variables. It confronts §3's anticipation problem directly rather than controlling for it, and it separates the labour-supply channel the scope named as the largest route-out. Priority read.
Maternal age and neonatal survival in rural Tanzania.
Determinants of place of delivery in rural Tamil Nadu.
No abstract; childbearing and marital histories and women's retirement.
Single motherhood, LIVING ARRANGEMENTS and mothers' time with children in Japan. Arrangement as exposure, time use as outcome.
